title: pi-context-refs approvals
description: The Approvals of Project Dynamic Refs: ~/.pi/agent/pi-context-refs-approvals.json. See DESIGN.md section 10.3. The file lives in the agent directory and never in a project, so a repository cannot approve itself. Edit it with /ref approve and /ref revoke.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, so an editor can validate the file.

approvals.description: One Approval for each Project Dynamic Ref that has one. A new Approval of the same project and Ref name replaces the old one.

project.description: The canonical path of the project (symlinks followed).

name.description: The Ref's name. Names are case-insensitive.

hash.description: The SHA-256 of the approved definition: source, argv or URL, and the directory a command runs in.

definition.description: The approved definition as one line, for /ref approvals. The hash decides, not this text.
